Victor (release-lead): target tiny window 22:00-22:05 UTC to push rti:v2.4.0-canary + router header toggle. quick ack and blockers?
Anya (runtime): ack. plan: pin image rti:v2.4.0-canary, pause autoscale at min=2, disable the perf-experiments feature flag.
Diego (router): ack. router will do header-based split with linear ramp 5->20->60->100. hold if p95 increases >200ms or any 5xx spike.
Rhea (console): console will lock model selector and show a notice. I'll add rollback snippet and notify CS.
Victor (release-lead): rollback triggers: +3% error rate OR p99 > 750ms for 2m. Marta oncall?
Marta (oncall): I'm watching. will acknowledge any deploy-bot rollback within 3m. alerts configured.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: service=runtime variant=rti:v2.4.0-canary canary_pct=5 window=4m (ts=1787659023).
Anya (runtime): smoke: `curl -H "x-variant: rti-v2.4.0-canary" https://api.internal/health` ; core logs tailing.
deploy-bot: canary started at 5% (ts=1787659030).
Marta (oncall): initial metrics p50=42ms p95=180ms errors +0.05%. green so far.
Diego (router): ramping to 20% now.
deploy-bot: ramp complete 20% (ts=1787659075).
Anya (runtime): KV cache stable, no unusual GC.
Marta (oncall): one transient p95 blip to 340ms for 30s, back to baseline. no alerts firing.
Victor (release-lead): proceed to 60% in 2m if green. final go for full rollout after 6m stable.
deploy-bot: ramp to 60% complete (ts=1787659120).
Diego (router): header flag at v4-compat across 60% routes. ready to revert quickly.
Marta (oncall): monitoring still nominal. no rollback.
deploy-bot: full rollout initiated -> 100% (ts=1787659155).
Rhea (console): leaving console lock for 20m post-rollout, then unlock and post summary.
Victor (release-lead): thanks all. I'll post a short deploy note after the window and mark for follow-up only if customer errors >1% in 24h. :tada:
